caption: Figure 4.14 Representative pedigree analysis of (a) Autosomal dominant trait (for example: Myotonic dystrophy) (b) Autosomal recessive trait (for example: Sickle-cell anaemia)
note: The two pedigree charts carry no printed labels other than the panel letters; individuals are shown only as symbols. Caption runs over two printed lines, joined with a single space. The crop over-includes a clipped line at the top ("pedigrees for characters linked to both autosomes and sex chromosome."), a clipped line at the bottom (bold "Colour Blindness" followed by "It is a sex-linked recessive disorder due to defect in ..."), and an orange page-number tab at the bottom right; all excluded.
